name: Summer Internship in Structural Engineering
description: The aim of this course is to facilitate the interaction of students with external stakeholders such as industry, national laboratories, government agencies, and other academic institutions. Students will develop skills in problem-solving, teamwork, communication, and project execution, while understanding ethical practices and the practical impact of their work.
